The ability to run TLS decryption with root is an experimental feature. This is a list of known bugs:

 - in KotSafe you will see the traffic as it was generated from the mitm-addon app in place of the original app
 - dump of the SSL keylog is not supported
 - when an app filter is set, decryption will only occur for the target app, but KotSafe will still show the other apps traffic
 - if the capture fails to start, ensure that you can actually run the iptables command as root (e.g. via termux)
 - this may not work on Android 12 and later
 - if a VPN app is running, you should either target a specific app for decryption or exclude the KotSafe mitm addon from the VPN, otherwise traffic will go in a loop
